procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: An incident occured between NOR 222627 and NED 225664 at the end of race 8 at approximately 14:30.
There was no injury or damage.
NOR 222627 came ashore, rigged down the boat and had a briefing with his coach.
After the briefing, NOR 222627 attempted to file the request for redress.
30 minutes later, NOR 222627 went to the race office to get help with filing the request for redress.
NOR 222627 filed the request for redress at 17:44.
The protest time limit for ILCA 6 gold fleet was 17:07.
conclusions: NOR 222627 failed to deliver the request for redress within the protest time limitas required by RRS 61.2(b)(1). There was no good reason for the InternationalJury to extend the time.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
